::: {.bio}
Outside of work, I'm pretty much always chasing the next great film, planning my next trip, or editing photos from the last one. Cinema has been a lifelong passion — there's something about the way a good story is told visually that I find endlessly fascinating. That same curiosity about the world is what drives me to travel as much as I can, and I rarely go anywhere without a camera. Photography has become my way of slowing down and really paying attention to a place.

When I'm not doing any of that, I'm usually deep in some personal tech project at home — whether that's tinkering with a self-hosted server setup or finding a better way to organize my digital life. It's the same itch that drew me to systems work professionally, just pointed in a different direction.
:::
